title: Deterministic fail-closed context_only role interpretation across Capital Flow outputs
instructions: PUBLIC CAPITAL FLOW QUALITY ONLY, pinned to exact base_sha. Current handoff.py _is_context_only, runner.py _scoring_history, and evidence_health.py build_evidence_health all use bool(dict(obs.provenance).get('context_only', False)), so string 'false' incorrectly becomes True and excludes valid scoring evidence. Implement ONE shared role predicate in contracts.py and use it consistently in those three consumers; do not duplicate inconsistent parsers. Missing context_only defaults to scoring (False). Boolean True/False retain semantics; explicit strings 'true'/'false' (case/whitespace insensitive) and optionally standard 1/0 yes/no must parse predictably. Ambiguous nonempty strings or malformed values must fail closed as context-only, never silently become scoring evidence. Preserve source provenance, immutable FlowObservation, point-in-time filtering, source-evidence role labels, scoring/history eligibility, scoring freshness/missingness, existing numeric formulas and source collector behavior. Add deterministic no-network regression tests for boolean and string false/true across _scoring_history, build_anata_handoff/source_evidence roles and build_evidence_health (including old scoring row + fresh context-only row not refreshing scoring freshness); test malformed value fail-closed and absent key defaults scoring. Avoid changing normalization same-rank provenance conflict behavior: that is a separate unresolved issue. Edit ONLY listed allowed_write_paths; no automation, .github, main, private, secrets, prediction, API/model orchestration, Telegram, MT5, broker, execution or Railway. Run targeted pytest and full Capital Flow pytest BEFORE committing; git diff --check must pass; if failure, fail closed and record concrete error.
